title: The consumer journey is CPG marketing’s ‘North Star’ — and why brands can’t discount promotion strategies
description: With the exponential growth of AI and the media landscape’s continued fragmentation, savvy CPG marketers are focused on connecting media, promotions and commerce to drive incremental sales. A new study from Circana and Ibotta Inc shows that promotions can deliver measurable incremental business outcomes. Partner insights from Ibotta.

title: Academy Sports and Outdoors taps Instacart for same-day delivery
description: The sporting goods retailer, which partnered with Uber Eats earlier this year, will charge the same price for products as in its stores.

description: Sales barely rose, tariff refunds padded the bottom line and customers were choosy, but the retailer held its own in Q2, analysts said.

title: Home Depot CEO takes medical leave, retailer announces interim plans
description:

title: HubSpot AEO vs. Profound: Features, pricing, and use cases
description: HubSpot AEO vs. Profound is a comparison between two answer engine optimization tools that take different approaches to AI search visibility. HubSpot AEO tracks how a brand appears in AI-generated answers and connects those insights directly to content creation and campaign execution inside the HubSpot ecosystem.

title: Ahrefs Brand Radar alternatives for marketing teams
description: G2’s 2026 Answer Economy research found that 51% of B2B software buyers start their research with an AI chatbot more often than Google. That shift means marketing teams need to track not only traditional search performance but also how AI assistants and answer engines mention, cite, and recommend brands.

title: Scrunch AI alternatives compared: Features, pricing, and fit [2026]
description: If you’re comparing Scrunch alternatives, start by separating monitoring from execution. Monitoring tools show how brands appear in AI-generated answers. Optimization tools add recommendations, content briefs, or workflows that help teams act on those findings.

title: Panera Bread hires CMO from Cava as transformation work continues
